text:
A change-of-mind return costs a flat **$6.95**, deducted from your refund. It's free if you're a Leafy Plus member.

This applies to non-living items (pots, tools, soil, fertiliser, grow lights, accessories) returned within **30 days** of delivery, unused and in original packaging. Opened soil or fertiliser can't be returned unless faulty. Live plants can't be returned for change of mind.

Once you start the return from "My Orders", the prepaid label is emailed to you and expires after **7 days**. Your refund is issued within **5 business days** of the item reaching our warehouse.
